title: feat: native Python analysis with retained chat outputs (#1327)
body:
## Issue Scope
Closes #1327. Builds on merged native sandbox infrastructure PR #1375 (#352).

Python analysis runs inside Mana's hidden native AppContainer helper, with pandas, matplotlib and openpyxl. Original input files are never granted sandbox access. User-offered files and approved attachment bytes are copied into disposable scratch; document content cannot authorize another host-file read.

Charts and table previews render inline in native chat. Generated files and PNGs have a Save as menu. Bounded output copies are stored with the chat, survive restart and reply-version changes, and are deleted with their chat. Forked chats retain independent copies. Binary outputs never enter the model's prompt or conversation search.

Every run exposes code, output and failures in activity. Stop terminates the active helper and waits for scratch/profile/ACL cleanup. Native build/update provisions and verifies the analysis Python bundle; replacement bundles are staged and validated before swapping. Interrupted downloads close their streams before staging cleanup.

## Verification So Far
- Full local Node suite passed in 495 seconds, followed by focused checks for subsequent changes.
- 117 focused analysis, approval, activity and route checks passed; the final download transport regression tests also pass.
- 22 live/focused analysis checks passed, including Stop, backend termination, CSV calculation, chart/table generation, downloadable CSV and cleanup.
- Full native suite: 1,481 passed, 28 existing skips. Wide/narrow native chat render checks show inline outputs and a compact Save menu.
- Real native Release build passed with bundled runtime dependency verification.
- Clean Windows CI verified first-time runtime provisioning. Every final-head check passed on 0ea55e3bd3fbfea417d3fb83f379cf542c3f6236, including full Node/desktop tests, native launcher build/tests, live native sandbox, .NET build/tests, DCO and CodeQL.
- Analysis finishing after chat deletion does not recreate the deleted chat. Live XLSX export/read-back also passed.

## Three Clean Reviews
After the final implementation change, three consecutive reviews completed without further changes:
1. Input permissions, untrusted output boundaries and backend contracts: 141 focused checks passed.
2. Output retention, versioning, fork/delete lifecycle and process ownership: 27 live/focused checks passed, with no sandbox/Python processes left behind.
3. Native display/save integration and runtime provisioning: 1,481 native tests passed (28 existing skips), wide/narrow render checks passed, and a clean Windows build verified fresh runtime installation.

## Merge Gate
Three clean reviews completed and all checks passed on the exact final head.

Separate issue PR, linked to #1327 through the closing reference above.
